draft_key_information_units.information: Revenue increased 25% to DKK 25.3m in 2025 from DKK 20.3m in 2024, with EBITDA loss improving by 77% to DKK 2.0m from DKK 9.3m in 2024; H2 2025 achieved positive EBITDA of DKK 0.5m compared to H2 2024 loss of DKK 3.6m.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Pages 24-25 (Periodic Reporting), Page 29 (Financial Highlights), Page 30 (Financial Review)

draft_key_information_units.information: Contracted Annual Recurring Revenue (CARR) grew 15% to DKK 24.4m; new sales rose 45% to DKK 4.5m; Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) payback period improved to 23 months from 43 months; ARR churn rate increased to 12.6% from 10.5%, with churn expected to decline to 6-9% in 2026.

Expanded product suite from consolidation tool to Konsolidator Suite, including Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) tool launched in January 2026 and Financial Data Management solution launched in April 2025, enhancing OCFO integration and customer lifetime value.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Pages 12-13 (Strategy: Build, Buy, Partner), Pages 18-19 (Product expansion details)

draft_key_information_units.information: Acquired 52 new customers (38% via partners), increasing average customer size to TDKK 87 from TDKK 70; partner-driven growth model reduced customer acquisition costs and enabled geographic expansion into Portugal, Chile, France, and Malaysia.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Page 8 (Letter from Chair), Page 24 (Key events), Page 15 (Market expansion)

draft_key_information_units.information: Operational efficiency improved through marketing department restructuring (saving DKK 3m), optimized onboarding processes reducing churn terminations, and cost discipline enabling positive EBITDA in H2 2025 and improved cash flow from primary activities.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Page 8 (Letter from CEO), Page 13 (Resilience pillar), Page 30 (Financial Review)

draft_key_information_units.information: Secured DKK 4.8m via two private placements in 2025 to fund operations and product development; parent company Konsolidator A/S maintained positive equity of DKK 0.7m despite consolidated negative equity of DKK 3.6m.

2026 guidance targets CARR of DKK 27-29m, revenue of DKK 27-29m, and EBITDA of DKK 1-2m, based on disciplined cost control, partner model expansion, and new product adoption; expects churn to decline to 6-9% and positive operating cash flow.

Konsolidator Iberia grew 200% to 30 customers in its first year (2024-2025), becoming the third-largest market; local team of 8 employees leverages Microsoft ecosystem and partner model for mid-market focus in Spain/Portugal with plans for LATAM expansion in 2026.

evaluation.selection_rationale: Prioritized headline financial performance (D1), key SaaS metrics reflecting growth/profitability (D2), strategic product expansion (D3), customer acquisition and partner-driven growth (D4), operational efficiency drivers (D5), capital structure and liquidity (D6), forward-looking guidance (D7), and material segment development (D8). Excluded routine boilerplate (governance, remuneration, risk lists, accounting policies). Each unit represents an independently omittable material theme with source evidence and reference support.
